name: Customer reply drafting
summary: Every customer gets the reply your best person would write. Hand over the customer's message, your tone guide and your approved answers, and get back a draft in your voice where every statement and every promise traces to something you approved. A person on your team reads it, edits it and sends it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: approved material as the only authority, every promise traced to the rule that allows it, and a person who sends.

sources.contribution: The method this template adapts: establish the situation, channel and relationship first; fit the tone to the situation; build a reply that acknowledges, answers, gives next steps and closes; size it to the channel; hand it over with private notes for the sender; and name the situations that go to someone senior before a reply. The writing defaults used when a tone guide is silent also follow its guidance: first person for the sender's own commitments, the customer's own terms, specific dates, no passing of blame, and shorter replies for chat than for email.
